answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 47355 Country: India Title: request new name for male born baby Question: Alhamdulillah by the grace of Allah we were blessed with a male baby on 17 Jun-2013. During the time of birth we kept his surname Muhammad after Azan. Now we request you to provide us some of good meaningful names to add with surname of Muhammad. Also please let us know about aqiqah (Qurbani) to whom we should distribute the meat of aqiqah and for whom we should not? Answer ID: 47355 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1438/1074/H=10/1434) (1) It was good that you kept the name of new born Muhammad after azan. (2) You may add Ahmad, Amjad, Arqam, Ahsan which you like with Muhammad. May Allah bless Muhammad with knowledge and good deed, and keep him safe from all evils, bless him with the virtues of both the worlds and give him prosperous life. Amen! (3) Slaughter two he-goats with the intention of aqiqah and divide its meat into three parts like of that qurbani meat. Give one share to the poor and needy ones, one share to relatives and near and dear ones and keep one share for yourselves. After shaving the head rub saffron and fragrance etc on his head and give silver in charity equal to the weight of his hair or its price. The ruling of aqiqah meat is same as of qurbani. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
